predecessors.diagnosticOnly: #893 retrospective eight-drive ceiling; no reused score

estimator.kind: damped Gauss-Newton shooting of initial state only
estimator.stateInput: first 17 observed states only; supplied latent initial states prohibited
estimator.verification: score indices 17..128 only, standardized RMS <=3, same suffix for legacy and prefix fits

noise: Independent Gaussian draws at every time/channel. Sigma equals centered clean trajectory channel SD *10^(-dB/20), supplied as synthetic calibrated sensor scale; no whole-record mean removal or RMS rescaling. Nominal SNR is expected, not exact realized SNR. This differs prospectively from the old normalized-noise cohorts.
comparisons: For every arm use identical acquired records for the old first-observation initializer and the new fixed-prefix shooting initializer. Both are evaluated on the same suffix. Active/random retain equal excitation power and acquisition count. Passive differential comparison retains a fixed two-coefficient law dictionary and is not unrestricted SINDy.
memory: Same shared bounded twin-reset witness and preparation as protocol-v2; archive original observations, bounds and witness. No tuning from memory or verification outcomes.
sham: Apply each planner to its own time-permuted pilot; acquire that drive, permute response and independent verification, preserve supplied commands. Both estimators score the same suffix. Any admitted time-permuted law counts false positive.
primary: New contender correct strictly exceeds new random and new passive; zero wrong, time-permuted, and outside admissions. Report every arm, old/new paired contingencies, initialization failures, all suffix errors and observed realized SNR. A tie or loss fails; never shrink denominator or change thresholds.
estimatorGate: New contender correct exceeds its old-initializer counterpart on the identical suffix with no increase in wrong, sham or outside admissions. This is a separate estimator improvement, never a substitute for the primary active superiority gate.
scope: Synthetic finite-roster noisy-state evidence only; no physical transfer, unrestricted law-discovery, external human, ARC or complete parent-oracle qualification.
integration: Shared prefix solver consumed by maintained field-law identification and optional public symbolic state-trajectory forecasts/model selection. Preserve historical default behavior and original protocol results.
qualification: Exact-head full npm verification and source distribution, launched product HTTP integration, original state-operator external course, and this complete fresh registered course. Preserve all failed/partial originals; no outcome-driven protocol edits.
